cards.title: THERE
lines: Use **there** to say that something **exists** or **is happening.**
**There** is a problem. **There** was an accident.
Use **there** to say **when** or **where** something is.
**There** is a party tomorrow. **There** are some cups on the table.

cards.title: IT
lines: Use **it** for **times and dates:** **It’s** four o’clock. **It’s** my birthday today.
Use **it** for the **weather:** **It** rained a lot yesterday. **It’s** four degrees.
Use **it** for **distance:** **It’s** 2 kilometres from the hotel.
Use **it** for something **again** — something already known.

blocks.title: Use **there** the first time — **it** / **they** after that

lines.text: **There** are some cups on the table. But **they** are dirty.
**There** is a party tomorrow. **It** will be fantastic!
The worst part of the exam ~~it’s~~ the speaking.
The worst part of the exam **is** the speaking.
